Questions parents ask

The short answers.

When does it start?

Season one starts in 2027. Everyone on the list hears first when sign-ups open.

Do I pay anything now?

No. Joining the list is free and doesn’t sign your kid up for anything yet.

What game do they play?

League of Legends, a team game where five players have to communicate and work together to win.

Where does it happen?

Online, from home. No driving, no cleats, no parking.

Who are the coaches?

Experienced players who are trained to coach kids. You’ll meet them before the season starts.
